description: Ollama is an open-source tool for running large language models locally. It simplifies the process of downloading, configuring, and serving LLMs on consumer hardware.
Qwen3 is a family of language models developed by Alibaba Cloud. The 4B variant has 4 billion parameters and offers a good balance between capability and resource requirements for local deployment.

Sentence Transformers is a Python library for computing dense vector representations of sentences and paragraphs. The all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model produces 384-dimensional embeddings and is widely used for semantic search.
